evidence_quote: the number of free cones given away is 50 cones / 6 = 8.333... free cones.
question_evidence_quote: every sixth customer gets a free ice cream cone
observed_error: The response divides the number of paid cones by six to calculate free cones.
violated_condition: Each complete group of six customers includes five paying customers and one receiving a free cone.
error_description: The response treats the 50 paid cones as the total customer count and divides by six. Every sixth customer receives a free cone, so each complete group contains five paid cones and one free cone. The division is executed correctly, but it uses the wrong relation.
